title: Rearview
summary:
Rearview is a spell that allows Seekers to visualise behind them without turning their heads. On the downside, the Seeker is temporarily unable to see what is in front of them, which might result in the Seeker walking into something.

When a Seeker uses Rearview, their eyes glow blue. A pair of mystical eyes appears on the back of their head. The scene behind them appears to the user within a blue glow.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Rearview was used by [[Lok Lambert]] to check for followers. However, Lok was unable to see ahead of him and walked face first into a shop sign. {{source|Den vs Harrison}}
